sections.overview:
Crataeva Nurvala / Varun / Holy Garlic Pear – Uses, Benefits, Properties & Dosage 

 Abstract 
 Diuretics are medicines that help in eliminating excessive water accumulation from the body also known as water pills. Most Diuretics promote water elimination by promoting the kidney function and increasing the elimination of water and salt via urine. But if people use more Diuretics it may lead to various side effects such as Dizziness, Headache, Muscle Cramps, Gout, Erectile Dysfunction, etc. So to prevent such side effects there is a better Herbal Diuretics, among which we are going to discuss one of them – Varun (Crataeva Nurvala) .

sections.morphology:
Height of this tree is 10-20 metres and it’s a deciduous plant. Bark of this tree is grey in colour with vertical striations and it’s bitter in taste. Leaves are trifoliate means it has 3 leaves together, approx 18 cm in height and are ovoid in shape with sharp tip. Flowers of Varun are yellowish and white in colour and have fragrance. Fruits of this herb are round or oval in shape having 2.5 cms of diameter and contain multiple seeds in yellowish pulp. Fruits come in the month of June and the flowering season of Varun is march. 


 Classical Categorisation 

 As per Charak Samhita – Tikta Skanda (Herbs having bitter taste) 
 As per Acharya Sushruta – Varunadi Gana (Manage Abnormal Growths) 
 In Dhanwantari Nighantu – Amradi Gana (Herbs having edible fruits) 
 In Raj Nighantu – Prabhadradi Varga (Group of Herbal Medicinal Plants) 
 In Bhavprakash Nighantu – Vatadi Varga (Herbs with Anti-pyretic, Antitussive, and Anti-inflammatory properties) 



 Ancient Verses 
 Shloka No 1 
 “वरुणो वरणः सेतुस्तिक्त शाकः कुमारकः। बरुणः पित्त्लो भेदी श्लेष्म कृच्श्राष्म मारूतान्। निहन्ति गुल्म्वातास्त्र कृमींश्वोष्णो अग्निदीपनः।। कषायो मधुरस्तिक्तः कटुको रूक्षको लघुः।” 
 (भ.प्र वटादि वर्ग ६५-६६) 
 Shloka Interpretation – Varun, Varan, Setu, Tiktashaak and Kumaarak are various synonyms of Varun Herb. This herb has Kshaya (Astringent), Madhur (Sweet) and Katu (Pungent) Rasa (Taste). It has rooksha (dry) and laghu (light to digest) properties. It increases the Pitta Dosha, promotes mala bhedana (divide waste into small portions), have Ushna veerya (hot in potency) and promotes Agni deepak (Induces hot potency). It manages various issues such as Kaphaj disorders, Mutrakrich (UTI), Kidney Stones, Abdominal tumour, Gout and worm infestations. 
 Shloka No 2 
 “वरुणः श्वेतपुष्पश्च तिक्तशाकः कुमारकः। श्वेतद्रुमो गन्धवृक्षस्तमालो मारूतापहः।।” 
 (ध.नि – अम्रादि वर्ग/१०९) 
 Shloka Interpretation – As per this shloka synonyms of Varun are Shvetpushp, Tiktshaka, Kumaraka, shwetdruma, gandvriksha, tamala and marutapaha. 
 Shloka No 3 
 “वरुणः शीतवातघ्नस्तिक्तो विद्रधिजन्तुजित्। तथा च कटुरुष्णश्च रक्तदोषहरः परः।।” 
 (ध.नि – अम्रादि वर्ग/११०) 
 Shloka Interpretation – As per this phrase Varun has various actions and properties which includes Cold and Vata Pacifier, bitter, pungent, heals abscess, manage worm infestation and blood disorders.

 The cleansing properties of Varun help in reducing Urea and creatinine levels as well. 
 It also consists of blood-purifying properties which help in preventing various skin diseases.
